note: OpenCode uses opencode.json for configuration. Model selection is per-agent via the agent frontmatter 'model' field or global defaults in opencode.json.

tier-s.rationale: OpenCode supports multiple providers. gpt-4o is the primary for design/implementation due to strong tool-use and code generation.

tier-a.rationale: Spec and QA need the same strength. gpt-4o's structured JSON mode is excellent for EARS requirements output.

tier-b.rationale: gpt-4o-mini is ~15x cheaper than gpt-4o. Handles discovery, domain modeling, and task planning with adequate quality.

tier-c.rationale: Lite agent and knowledge accumulation are high-volume. gpt-4o-mini is the clear cost winner.
